projects.title: .Insider Unlocked
projects.description: Data analysis tools: Matplotlib, Pandas, BeutifulSoup, NumpyWeb app tools: Django, React.JS, Ant Design, and SQLite- Scraped information regarding trading data of US senators using BeautifulSoup.- Completed data analysis and gathered interesting stats using tools such as Matplotlib, and Pandas in a Jupyter Notebook.- Co-Developed a full-stack web app with a Django web server serving as a REST API and React.JS as the front-end which gathered over 5000 views.

projects.title: Chat Watch
projects.description: Tools: Django, NLTK, TextBlob, Pandas, SQLite React, Chakra-UI- Developed a natural language processing algorithm which detects whether a comment is negative or positive using NLTK, and TextBlob.- Developed an API at which given a stream link returns stats regarding a stream's chat using Django.- Developed a web app which visualizes stats of any given stream's chat using React.

projects.title: Crypto Venture Tracker
projects.description: Tools: Django, React.JS, Tailwand CSS, and SQLite- Scraped information regarding the investment of cryptocurrency exchanges using beautifulsoup.- Co-Developed a full-stack web app with a Django web server serving as a REST API and React.JS as the front-end.

projects.title: Ontario Universities - Admissions Summary
projects.description: Tools: Pandas, Jupyter Notebook, Streamlit, matplotlib, plotly, numpy- Scraped averages of admitted students in the admissions sequence of 2021-2022 from multiple sources.- Completed data analysis on specific programs in hopes of achieving interesting data by graphing histograms, calculating admission averages etc. all in a Jupyter Notebook.- Visualized all the data and built a web application using Streamlit.

projects.title: Sit Up!
projects.description: Tools: Flask, HTML, CSS, Javascript, Sklearn, Tensorflow, Movenet- Developed a classification system at which detects the 7 key points that effect a person's posture using Tensorflow, and Movenet.- Developed an artificial neural network which detects whether a person has a good or bad posture using Tensorflow, and Sklearn.- Developed a web app to notify users when their posture is bad through sound and notification cues using Flask.

honors_and_awards.title: PicoCTF 2022 - 3rd In Canada out of 340 teams, 15th globally out of 7700+ teams
honors_and_awards.description: PicoCTF is a capture-the-flag styled online cybersecurity competition, open to anyone who is interested. Topics include Reverse Engineering, Binary Exploitation, Cryptography, Web Exploitation and Forensics.

honors_and_awards.title: Avogadro's Chemistry Exam 2021 - Top 20% Distinctions
honors_and_awards.description: The Avogadro Exams is a challenging online exam written by more than 6000 grade 11 high school students every May, and consist of 40 multiple choice questions written in a 75 minute exam period. Topics include: structure of matter, bonding, reactions, solutions, and gases. The test includes a few probing and demanding questions on some of the main topics of high school chemistry.

honors_and_awards.title: Canadian Computing Competition 2021 - Top 25% Distinctions
honors_and_awards.description: The Canadian Computing Competition (CCC) is a contest for secondary school students with an interest in programming. It is an opportunity for students to test their ability in designing, understanding and implementing algorithms.

honors_and_awards.title: Canadian Senior Mathematics Exam 2020 - Top 25% Distinctions
